authority_bridge_launch.note: Headless authority bridge: starts the Node Language ApplicationServer on an OS-assigned local port with Universal machine transport enabled. It does not bind 8482/8484 or stop a copied host, but it can supersede graph ownership if both use the same Universal state. Do not launch it while a live default state owner is present; use a controlled founder-approved handoff.
